designationHistory.name: Cabeza Prieta Game Range
designationHistory.indexText: President Franklin D. Roosevelt established the Cabeza Prieta Game Range by Executive Order 8038; it is now Cabeza Prieta National Wildlife Refuge.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Cabeza Prieta National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
American Presidency Project: Executive Order 8038—Establishing the Cabeza Prieta Game Range (Jan 25, 1939)

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Cabeza Prieta National Wildlife Refuge was originally established in 1939 as a Game Range for the conservation and development of natural wildlife resources.
